entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 7B Q4_K_M v8 plus rejected target-scoped and exact-occurrence experimental term transformers
entries.expected_invariant: A hint for one target noun must preserve every contrasting unhinted referent and its availability or negation.
entries.last_outcome: Exact-occurrence candidate repairs all twelve known positive observations, but loses the available stand in all three REG-062 reproducers and all three two-speaker controls; rejected, product v8 unchanged.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 1.8B Q4_K_M v8 source-name profiles; NAME-02 admission-only safety containment
entries.expected_invariant: A target-scoped name proposal must preserve the target person's arrival-time question and must not replace it with the neighboring file-transfer action.
entries.last_outcome: NAME-02 fail-closed admission contains active proposals before checkpoint; linguistic fix and human review remain open. Keep baseline v8, no long file.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 1.8B Q4_K_M v8 batch4; shared v7/v8 provider validation
entries.expected_invariant: Only terminal CR/LF layout characters in decoded target text may be removed; identity, control, money and JSON-leak checks still run before checkpoint.
entries.last_outcome: A single committed-binary copy resume reached 467/467 cues; its fresh cue-113 reply had no terminal LF, so deterministic controls alone isolate normalization. Language quality remains open.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 1.8B and 7B Q4_K_M v8 batch4 on the same 467-cue original-platform Vivo SRT
entries.expected_invariant: Keep generation, 36-month lead, thousand-person team, 01:00–02:00 and future-product modality across source cue boundaries.
entries.last_outcome: A 20-chat same-source 7B batch/focus screen repaired zero of three primary relation errors. Five authored contrasts stayed correct; the focus candidate was rejected.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 1.8B and 7B Q4_K_M v8 on the same original Vivo SRT
entries.expected_invariant: A four-target reply at the end of the file must include every original cue ID in order, including the final thank-you cue; an incomplete reply cannot become a checkpoint.
entries.last_outcome: Three authored four-slot cases and the original three-slot tail returned all IDs in one 7B screen. Older shifted 1.8B/7B omissions remain historical; no fix or promotion.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 1.8B Q4_K_M v8 shifted natural Vivo cue group
entries.expected_invariant: Translate a Chinese reference to the 9400 generation into Russian without introducing an unlicensed French common word; preserve legitimate source proper names and quoted foreign words.
entries.last_outcome: One 7B screen kept authored quoted foreign words distinct and repaired one current-9400 case. The historical 1.8B shifted mixed-script failure remains unfixed.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 7B Q4_K_M v8 plus rejected evaluation-only source-fact hints
entries.expected_invariant: Russian target text must not contain copied JSON wrapper punctuation; the v7/v8 provider rejects it before a checkpoint and retains the raw reply for review.
entries.last_outcome: Direct chat parsed IDs but leaked wrapper punctuation into four target strings; existing product v7/v8 decoder rejects before checkpoint. Hint candidate rejected.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 7B Q4_K_M v8 plus rejected evaluation-only source-fact hints
entries.expected_invariant: With source context indicating after midnight, a Chinese one-or-two-o'clock statement must remain approximately 01:00–02:00, not shift to 11:00–12:00 at night.
entries.last_outcome: Paired natural cue 328 changed a correct 01:00–02:00 baseline to 11:00–12:00 at night; no product fix, candidate rejected.

entries.profile_scope: evaluation-only source relation diagnostic v1/v2 and rejected 7B focus-slot candidate
entries.expected_invariant: When immediately preceding Chinese context expresses expectation and the current cue describes better products that could be brought later, an explicit Russian statement that better products already exist needs review even without an owner phrase.
entries.last_outcome: The saved bare-present focus reply escaped v1 but v2 warned offline. Both diagnostics remain evaluation-only; the focus candidate and product quality advancement were rejected.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 7B Q4_K_M v8 plus rejected scene-level post-edit pass
entries.expected_invariant: If a source scene says the team often works after midnight until about one or two in the morning, the Russian scene must not replace that hour with eleven or twelve at night or move an invented hour into the preceding cue.
entries.last_outcome: The 10-chat scene post-editor inserted 11–12 at night into the preceding cue and dropped the source 1–2 a.m. hour. Zero of three primary relations were confirmed repaired; candidate rejected, v8 unchanged.

entries.profile_scope: retained Hy-MT2 1.8B and 7B Q4_K_M v8 full-file drafts
entries.expected_invariant: Technical architecture, process terminology, scene causality, and adjacent-cue meaning must survive complete-file translation.
entries.last_outcome: Six purposively sampled windows have AI-only major meaning/scene findings across two retained full-file drafts; no human review, model calls, or quality admission.

entries.profile_scope: evaluation-only source quantity classifier v1/v2
entries.expected_invariant: Do not classify ordinal labels, idiomatic one-point wording, or separated product model names as measured source quantities.
entries.last_outcome: Source-only v2 removes five known v1 false-positive cues, with no added marks and ten authored controls passed; cross-source accuracy and translation gates remain open.

entries.profile_scope: rejected evaluation-only technical sense v1
entries.expected_invariant: An affirmative continuation adverb containing the character 不 must not suppress an exact target-slot semiconductor-process sense note; genuine negation and word mentions must still preserve baseline bytes.
entries.last_outcome: The frozen v1 candidate falsely abstained on affirmative process development; rejected before any model call.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 7B Q4_K_M v8 and rejected provisional technical-sense v2
entries.expected_invariant: When the source contrasts three distinct chips with a denial of multi-core architecture, preserve both the chip count and the negated multi-core concept; do not replace it with a denial of multi-processor operation.
entries.last_outcome: Twenty-eight real chats were structurally valid and two natural technical meanings improved, but the shared negated multi-core control failed; candidate rejected, v8 unchanged.

entries.profile_scope: unchanged v8 baseline and rejected evaluation-only negated-multicore v3
entries.expected_invariant: Keep chip count, cores per chip and the exact negated concept distinct; a target-scoped sense note cannot be admitted from one corrected sentence while related contrasts fail.
entries.last_outcome: The scoped candidate repaired one exposed negation but lost the related single-multi-core-chip distinction in all three seeds; another byte-identical control varied in one seed. Candidate rejected.

entries.profile_scope: unchanged v8 baseline and rejected evaluation-only negated-multicore v3
entries.expected_invariant: When the source says one core per processor, preserve that count with grammatical Russian agreement; do not change processor or core counts to repair grammar.
entries.last_outcome: All six real replies preserved one core per processor but used ungrammatical Russian agreement. Human review and model controls remain open.

entries.profile_scope: unchanged v8 baseline and rejected evaluation-only source-relation-card v4
entries.expected_invariant: Keep separate chips distinct from a single multi-core chip, with negation attached to the exact denied one-chip alternative; a source relation card cannot be admitted solely for recording the chip count.
entries.last_outcome: The source relation card still changed one multi-core chip into one multi-processor chip in all six exposed candidate replies; v4 rejected.

entries.profile_scope: unchanged v8 baseline and rejected evaluation-only source-relation-card v4
entries.expected_invariant: Use grammatical Russian agreement for one core without changing chip, processor or core counts; preserve the already grammatical distributive form and do not force it on two-core or unknown-count sources.
entries.last_outcome: Two additional one-core forms reproduced the Russian agreement error in all twelve paired replies; human review and new controls remain open.

entries.profile_scope: official Qwen3 8B Q4_K_M local evaluation configuration; product v8 unchanged
entries.expected_invariant: All-big-core architecture must retain the big-core modifier; a full set of unspecified cores is not the same architecture.
entries.last_outcome: Qwen3 drops the big-core modifier in all three natural repeats, including one matched v8 cell that preserved it; candidate rejected.

entries.profile_scope: official Qwen3 8B Q4_K_M local evaluation configuration; product v8 unchanged
entries.expected_invariant: Preserve the hardware counts with grammatical Russian gender and number agreement for chip, processor and core.
entries.last_outcome: Qwen3 retains hardware counts but repeats chip/processor/core agreement errors in six authored cells; v8 is grammatical in those controls.

entries.profile_scope: retained Hy-MT2 7B Q4 v8 full-draft result; product profile unchanged
entries.expected_invariant: A denial that the handheld has Hall-effect joysticks must retain both the joystick referent and Hall-effect technology; a galvanometric lever is a different device description.
entries.last_outcome: V3 emitted no warning on 268 aligned ASUS cues; AI triage found a Hall-stick technical substitution at cue 24; rule not admitted.
